PATTERN: 6-level cascade search in lib/vinted-search-strategy.ts

LEVELS (each drops a constraint if previous returns 0 results):
1. Full: brand_id + catalog_id + color_id + size_id + smart query
2. Drop size (too restrictive)
3. Drop color (Vinted color tagging inconsistent)
4. Simple query + catalog_id only
5. Simple query, no filters
6. Just the type name alone

GEMINI RETURNS: { type, color, brand, model, style, material } — no searchQuery anymore

QUERY CONSTRUCTION (our code):
- brand + model → "Nike Air Force 1"
- brand, no model → "Ralph Lauren polo"
- no brand → "leather belt"

CATALOG IDs (lib/vinted-catalog.ts): 60+ mappings e.g. watch→97, bag→94, belt→1743, sneakers→1242, sunglasses→26, t-shirt→1, trousers→3

BRAND IDs: Dynamically resolved via Vinted /api/v2/catalog/brands?keyword=BrandName, cached in-memory

WHY: Previous approach — relying on Gemini-generated search text — caused zero results for accessories (belt, watch, bag). Filters + cascade guarantee results.

FILES: lib/vinted-search-strategy.ts, lib/vinted-catalog.ts, lib/vinted-brand.ts, app/api/search/route.ts
